title.zh: 比特币因宏观数据与地缘冲突多次跌破关键价位并引发大规模清算
title.en: Liquidations jump to $547 million as oil rally hits crypto market

current_state.zh: 在 CPI 和 PPI 数据高于预期后，比特币跌破 80,000 美元，24 小时内引发近 9.48 亿美元的加密清算，使美国现货 ETF 持有者在其约 82,300 美元的平均成本基础附近陷入亏损。
current_state.en: Bitcoin slid below $80,000 after hotter-than-expected CPI and PPI data, driving nearly $948 million in crypto liquidations over 24 hours and leaving U.S. spot ETF holders underwater near their ~$82,300 average cost basis.

updates.title_zh: 油价上涨冲击加密市场，清算额跃升至 5.47 亿美元
updates.title_en: Liquidations jump to $547 million as oil rally hits crypto market
updates.what_changed_zh: 比特币跌破 84,000 美元，总清算额飙升 235% 至 5.47 亿美元，因伊朗在霍尔木兹海峡的局势升级推动布伦特原油突破 101 美元，较小代币以及 DeFi/meme 指数跌幅最大，Optimism 在 Abstract 成为一周内第二个关停的以太坊 L2 后下跌 10%。
updates.what_changed_en: Bitcoin fell below $84,000 and total liquidations jumped 235% to $547 million as an Iranian escalation in the Strait of Hormuz pushed Brent crude above $101, with smaller tokens and DeFi/meme indices falling hardest and Optimism dropping 10% after Abstract became the second Ethereum L2 to shut down within a week.

updates.title_zh: 加密货币清算接近10亿美元，比特币剧烈震荡
updates.title_en: Bitcoin Whipsaws as Crypto Liquidations Near $1 Billion
updates.what_changed_zh: 在 CPI 和 PPI 数据高于预期后，比特币跌破 80,000 美元，24 小时内引发近 9.48 亿美元的加密清算，使美国现货 ETF 持有者在其约 82,300 美元的平均成本基础附近陷入亏损。

updates.detailed_summary_en: Bitcoin slid below $80,000 after hotter-than-expected CPI and PPI data, driving nearly $948 million in crypto liquidations over 24 hours and leaving U.S. spot ETF holders underwater near their ~$82,300 average cost basis.
updates.background_zh: 清算是指当亏损使抵押品跌破交易所维持保证金要求时，杠杆仓位被强制自动平仓，由此产生的抛售会进一步压低价格并触发更多清算。此次的导火索是通胀数据：9月消费者价格同比上涨3.7%，高于3.6%的预期，核心通胀为2.6%，高于2.5%；周四公布的生产者价格指数同比上涨6.3%，高于5.5%的预期。Kalchev认为这更像是对风险资产的普遍撤离而非单纯的联储叙事，并列举了股市与铜价下跌、黄金上涨以及韩国Kospi指数下跌约8%。
updates.background_en: A liquidation is the forced, automatic closure of a leveraged position once losses push collateral below the exchange's maintenance margin, and the resulting forced selling can drag prices lower and trigger further liquidations. The trigger this time was inflation data: September consumer prices rose 3.7% year over year against a 3.6% forecast, with core inflation at 2.6% versus 2.5%, while Thursday's Producer Price Index rose 6.3% annually versus 5.5% expected. Kalchev framed the selloff as a broad exit from risk assets rather than purely a Fed story, citing falling stocks and copper, rising gold and a roughly 8% drop in South Korea's Kospi.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导主要通过杠杆与利率渠道：CPI/PPI数据超预期推高美债收益率与美元，抬高了杠杆加密仓位所依赖的廉价资金成本，其表现就是集中在比特币与以太坊永续合约上的多头强制平仓连锁反应。与此同时，持续跌破约82,300美元的现货ETF平均成本价，是ETF持有者仓位可能发生变化的通道；Kalchev认为，ETF资金流向因此成为需要关注的关键变量。
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission runs mainly through leverage and rates: a hot CPI/PPI print lifts Treasury yields and the dollar, raising the cost of the cheap money that leveraged crypto positions depend on, which shows up as a cascade of forced long liquidations concentrated in Bitcoin and Ethereum perpetuals. A sustained move below the ~$82,300 average spot ETF cost basis is also the channel through which ETF-holder positioning could shift, making ETF flows the level to watch, according to Kalchev.
